audit.regional_policy: Retain existing evidenced regional memberships and explicit exclusions; do not invent a region or substitute electoral wards.

regional_coverage.reason: Eight familiar geographic groupings supported by the Manitoba Arts Council map and census-division crosswalk. Winnipeg groups Winnipeg and Headingley (2025 division 11), not the full metropolitan region. Boundaries are derived from 2025 CSDs.
